name: tsoftmax16
summary: row softmax over TILES tiles of 16 rows x 32 f32 columns, max-subtracted
provenance: authored for OpenAccel Lab (Apache-2.0); the shape follows the tile kernels of aien-dev/omega-mv PR #869 (unmerged, head 6d08fd9c, seed/kflow/specs/tsoftmax.spec and seed/kflow/sm121/tsoftmax.s2)

y.why: Inputs lie in [60,100], so for any x and row max m, m/2 <= x <= m and x-m is exact in f32 (Sterbenz; WolframLanguageEvaluator: 100/60<2 -> True), |x-m| <= 40. Per element y = e/s with e = exp(x-m) within 3 ulp (OpenCL C 3.0 sec 7.4; covers CUDA expf 2 ulp, glibc expf, numpy float32 exp and the Omega binary64 exp rounded to f32), i.e. relative eps_e = 3*2^-23 = 6u; s = sum of 32 positive terms in any order within gamma(31) relative (Higham Thm 3.1, u=2^-24); the divide within 2.5 ulp (OpenCL single-precision x/y), i.e. 5u. Hence |y-ref| <= ((1+6u)(1+5u)/((1-6u)(1-gamma(31)))-1)*|ref|. WolframLanguageEvaluator: u=2^-24; gam[n_]:=n u/(1-n u); rt=(1+3*2^-23)(1+5/2*2^-23)/((1-3*2^-23)(1-gam[31]))-1; N[{gam[31],rt,rt/2^-23},12] -> {1.84774740220e-6, 2.86103211881e-6, 24.0000769201}. This re-derives PR #869's softmax bound (2.29976200922e-6, one warp butterfly of 5 additions and ex2.approx/rcp.approx) for 31 additions in any order and per-backend exp and divide accuracy. Outputs stay normal: WolframLanguageEvaluator: N[Exp[-40]/32 > 2^-126] -> True. Without max subtraction exp(x) overflows for x > 88.72 (WolframLanguageEvaluator: N[Log[(2-2^-23)*2^127],12] -> 88.7228390521), giving inf/NaN; one dropped column changes the row sum by e^(x-m)/s, above the bound in some row.
